key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target. One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED libraries
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The Android CMake build fails in ov_generate_plugins_hpp() (cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186), which calls ov_target_link_plugins() (plugins.cmake:325-327). This function tries to link plugin MODULE_LIBRARY targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_hetero_plugin, etc.) into another target, which CMake prohibits. This is a pre-existing deterministic bug in the Android build CMake configuration that is entirely unrelated to the PR changes (GPU clang-tidy only). The same failure has now been observed 3 times for this PR (#37211) and a previous PR (#37304). The underlying CMake configuration issue must be fixed before Android builds will succeed.
reproduction_steps: Run the Android CMake configure step with the same NDK and BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF settings used in the Android CI workflow. The ov_generate_plugins_hpp() call will fail because plugins are registered as MODULE_LIBRARY and ov_target_link_plugins() tries to link them statically.
recommended_actions: Fix cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake to handle MODULE_LIBRARY targets in ov_target_link_plugins() - either skip them or convert them to SHARED or STATIC for Android builds
Investigate why the Android build is registering plugins as MODULE_LIBRARY when they should likely be SHARED for Android
Check the ov_add_plugin() macro (around line 111) for Android-specific BUILD_SHARED_LIBS handling
File a tracking issue for the Android CMake build configuration bug to avoid blocking unrelated PRs
prevention_strategies: The Android CMake build configuration bug is a systemic issue. A dedicated CMake fix PR must be merged before any further PRs will succeed in the Android workflow. Consider adding a pre-merge check that validates CMake configuration on Android to catch such regressions earlier.
historical_context: Same failure seen in run 31231244014 (2026-08-08T01:04:42Z, PR #37304) and run 31257162423 (2026-08-08T12:39:01Z, PR #37211). This is the 3rd occurrence in under 12 hours, all for Android CMake configure on the same plugins.cmake:275 error.
